_comment: Idioms the API dump cannot express.
The dump marks deprecated *classes and members* with a Tags entry, which is
authoritative and machine-readable. What it does not encode is the thing that
actually hurts people on this forum: global functions that still work but are
the wrong answer (wait, spawn, delay), and replacements — the dump has no
PreferredDescriptorName anywhere, verified against the live file.
So the dump supplies WHAT is deprecated and this file supplies WHY IT MATTERS
and WHAT TO USE INSTEAD. Entries here also override the dump's severity.
access: 'method'   — only flag after ':' (a call like event:wait())
omitted    — either. Dump-derived entries default to this.
This distinction is load-bearing. Without it `task.wait(1)` — the *correct*
modern API — was flagged as the legacy `event:wait()` alias, which would have
told people the right answer was wrong. Caught by tests/unit/detect.test.ts.

wait.why: Throttled and imprecise. `task.wait()` resumes on the next frame with the real elapsed time, and returns it.

spawn.why: Defers by an unpredictable amount under load. `task.spawn()` runs immediately on a new thread.

delay.why: Same scheduler as `wait()`; drifts under load. `task.delay()` is precise.

LoadLibrary.why: Removed from the engine. Calling it errors.

printidentity.why: Debug-only global; not meaningful in shipped code.

ypcall.why: `pcall` has been yield-safe since Lua 5.1 in Roblox; `ypcall` is a legacy alias.

remove.why: `:remove()` only reparents to nil, leaving the instance alive and its connections intact. `:Destroy()` releases it.

connect.why: Legacy lowercase alias. Modern code uses `:Connect()`.

LoadAnimation.why: Loading on Humanoid or AnimationController is deprecated. Get the Animator and load on that so animations replicate correctly.

GetMouse.why: Mouse is a legacy object. UserInputService covers mouse, touch and gamepad in one API.

BodyVelocity.why: Superseded by the constraint-based mover. LinearVelocity works with the current physics solver.

Hint.why: Legacy top-bar UI, not styleable and not mobile-friendly.

instanceNewParent.why: The second argument to `Instance.new` parents the instance before its properties are set, which forces the engine to re-render and replicate each change. Set .Parent last instead.
